Data Engineer 4 (Manager, IC)-Risk Tech
Do you love building and pioneering in the technology space? Do you enjoy solving complex business problems in a fast-paced, collaborative, inclusive and iterative delivery environment? At Capital One, you'll be part of a big group of makers, breakers, doers and disruptors who solve real problems and meet real customer needs. We are seeking Data Engineers who are passionate about marrying data with emerging technologies. In this role, you’ll be at the forefront of driving a major transformation across Capital One.
In Risk Tech, we provide the foundation for Capital One to thrive in an uncertain world. Our engaged, empowered, and intelligent people produce outstanding products, working toward the common goal of transforming risk management with technology. We build data-driven tools that use machine learning to prevent risks & automatically detect issues before they impact our customers, our business, or our communities.
In this role at Risk Tech, you will work with our GRC team and partners across the company to build and deploy proprietary solutions for Risk management that are powered by state-of-the-art AI technology. Our products, enhanced with the transformative power of AI, are central to our business and deliver tremendous customer value.
What You’ll Do:
+ Collaborate with and across Agile teams to design, develop, test, implement, and support technical solutions in full-stack development tools and technologies
+ Influence a team of developers, data analysts and data scientists with deep experience in machine learning, distributed microservices, lakehouse architecture, and full-stack systems
+ Utilize programming languages such as Python and Spark, along with open-source relational and NoSQL databases, and cloud-based data warehousing platforms including Databricks and Snowflake
+ Share your passion for staying on top of trends in data, experimenting with and learning new technologies, participating in internal and external technology communities, and mentoring other members of the data community
+ Collaborate with product managers and software engineers to deliver robust cloud-first data solutions that drive powerful experiences to help millions of Americans achieve financial empowerment
+ Independently design, build and deliver world-class cloud data solutions and applications with little or no support from supervisors or managers
+ Architect and enforce common data engineering design patterns to ensure code quality, maintainability, and reusability across data platforms and pipelines
+ Serve as an ambassador for the data engineering team, communicating technical concepts and data outcomes clearly to both internal and external stakeholders to drive alignment and shared understanding
+ Design and build data pipelines and platforms with a focus on scalability, resilience, and operational efficiency, ensuring robust performance under increasing data volume and business demands
+ Implement data security standards, including encryption at rest/transit and fine-grained access control, ensuring compliance with data privacy regulations
Basic Qualifications:
+ Bachelor's Degree or higher in Computer Science or a related quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Engineering)
+ At least 4 years of experience in application development (Internship experience does not apply)
+ At least 2 years of experience in distributed data
+ At least 2 years of experience with SQL
+ At least 2 years of experience with one programming language (Python, Java, or Scala)
+ At least 2 years of experience in data pipeline design and development
+ At least 1 year of experience in data modeling and designing end-to-end data solutions using both relational and non-relational database systems
Preferred Qualifications:
+ 7+ years of experience in application development with demonstrated proficiency in Python, SQL, Scala, or Java
+ 4+ years of hands-on experience designing, deploying and operating data workloads in at least one public cloud environment (AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud)
+ 4+ years of experience building or supporting distributed data or compute workloads using tools such as EMR, Spark, Glue, or Databricks
+ 4+ years of experience designing, implementing, and operating real-time or streaming data pipelines
+ 2+ years of experience working on data observability (e.g., Monte Carlo, Splunk) or data orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow, Dagster)
+ 4+ years of experience working with unstructured or semistructured data using NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB, Cassandra, DynamoDB)
+ 4+ years of experience designing and supporting data warehousing solutions (e.g., Snowflake, Redshift)
+ 2+ years of experience working in an Agile development environment
+ 2+ years of experience developing user-centric reusable data products
At this time, Capital One will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization, or offer any immigration related support for this position (e.g. H1B, F-1 OPT, F-1 STEM OPT, F-1 CPT, J-1, TN, E-3, and O-1, or any other forms of work authorization that require immigration support from an employer).
The minimum and maximum full-time annual salaries for this role are listed below, by location. Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within one of these locations, and refers to the amount Capital One is willing to pay at the time of this posting. Salaries for part-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked.

Richmond, VA: $179,400 - $204,700 for Data Engineer 4

**Job Title:** AI-Augmented Data Engineer  

**Work Style / Location:** Hybrid; 3 days onsite per week in Reston, Virginia  

**Sector:** Data, AI & Analytics  

**Level:** Consultant, Senior, or Principal (depending on experience)  

**Type:** Full-Time  

**Candidate Profile:** Senior engineering background preferred (often 8–15 years, potentially including engineering management); practical multi-agent and MCP workflow experience  

**Client Focus:** Primarily commercial engagements; federal experience or an existing clearance is welcome, not required  

**Position Overview**  

BizFirst is supporting our client in identifying an AI-Augmented Data Engineer. This is a mid-senior, client-facing role for an engineer who combines genuine data engineering fundamentals with demonstrated AI-assisted delivery.  

Our client brings together high-performing technologists who drive measurable impact for clients. Its mission is to transform businesses and build a smarter, more connected world through the power of data, cloud, and modern technology. Global enterprise leaders rely on the company to design, architect, and deliver cutting-edge data and AI solutions.  

The company provides an environment where ambitious engineers thrive, offering continuous learning, diverse client engagements, strong mentorship, and the platform to deliver high-value work.  

**The Mission: Deliver Data Outcomes Through AI**  

The work of data engineering has changed. The pipelines, models, tests, and documentation that once took weeks of hand-coding can now be produced in hours by an engineer who knows how to direct AI well; and verify what it produces.  

As an AI-Augmented Data Engineer, you deliver client data outcomes by orchestrating AI coding agents and large language models, not by typing every line yourself. You decompose problems, drive tools like Claude Code and other agentic assistants to build the solution, and then apply hard engineering judgment to review, harden, and own the result. AI drafts; you are accountable for correctness, security, and performance.  

This is a mid-senior, client-facing role (roughly equivalent to historical Consultant / Senior Consultant levels). You bring genuine data engineering fundamentals; because you cannot supervise what you could not build yourself; paired with a demonstrated ability to move far faster by leveraging AI.  

**What You'll Be Driving**  

• **Ship production data pipelines by directing AI agents.** Design ingestion, transformation, and ELT workflows, drive AI tooling to implement them, and review, refactor, and harden the output to production standard.  

• **Turn client requirements into working data models fast.** Use LLMs to translate business needs into schemas, transformations, and tested code in a fraction of the traditional time; then validate the design against real constraints.  

• **Build automated, AI-driven data quality.** Generate test suites, anomaly detection, and validation checks with AI; use it to triage failures and surface root causes, so quality scales without scaling headcount.  

• **Own verification.** Treat every AI output as a draft to be proven, not trusted. Know the failure modes; hallucinated columns, silently wrong joins, plausible-but-broken logic; and catch them before clients do. Correctness is yours.  

• **Engineer your prompts and context like code.** Version, review, and reuse prompts, agent workflows, and context scaffolding as first-class delivery artifacts the whole team can build on.  

• **Accelerate discovery and de-risking.** Stand up prototypes, synthetic datasets, and proofs-of-concept quickly to help clients make decisions earlier and with more evidence.  

• **Generate and curate documentation.** Produce runbooks, SOPs, and technical docs with AI, then edit for accuracy; leaving engagements better documented than they used to be.  

• **Raise the team's AI leverage.** Coach teammates and clients on safe, effective AI-assisted delivery, and flag project risks and blockers early.  

• **Keep a modern data stack as the substrate.** Integrate AI tooling into a disciplined foundation; Snowflake/Databricks, dbt, Airflow, cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure), Git, and CI/CD.  

**Who You Are**  

We are seeking engineers who combine strong technical fundamentals with genuine, hands-on fluency in AI-assisted delivery. The best candidates are faster and more rigorous because of how they use AI; not in spite of it.  

**Ideal candidates demonstrate:**  

• Solid data engineering fundamentals; proficiency in SQL and Python, at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure), and real experience with ELT/ETL, data modeling, and warehousing (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, dbt, Airflow, Spark). You must be able to judge what the AI produces.  

• Demonstrated use of AI coding tools to ship real work; coding agents and assistants such as Claude Code, Claude, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor, and agentic workflows; with concrete examples of what you delivered and how AI changed the outcome.  

• Strong problem decomposition and prompt/context engineering instincts; the ability to break work into pieces an agent can execute, and to steer, correct, and iterate toward a correct result.  

• A verification mindset and healthy skepticism; you review everything, understand where AI goes wrong, and never let unverified output reach a client.  

• Clear communication and client awareness; able to explain technical solutions, and the role of AI in them, to peers and clients.  

• A learning orientation; continuous skill-building, with relevant cloud/data certifications (e.g., SnowPro, cloud practitioner/associate credentials) valued as part of that.  

• 4–8 years of hands-on experience in data engineering or a closely related field.  

**The Rewards**  

Our client invests in its people by providing comprehensive professional development, clear career progression, and an inclusive culture.  

• Gain access to a proprietary knowledge platform and internal training resources.  

• Receive direct guidance and career support through structured mentorship.  

• Earn fully funded paid professional certifications across major cloud and data platforms.  

**Perks & Benefits**  

• Connect with colleagues through regular team socials, events, interest groups, and gatherings.  

• Enjoy a hybrid work schedule with three days per week onsite in Reston, Virginia.  

• Fuel your workday with coffee, tea, and premium snacks provided daily in the office.
